title: Light Argentinian Lentils Bowl
description: A light and flavorful Argentinian inspired dish featuring brown lentils and a hint of citrus. This recipe is perfect for a quick and easy dinner or lunch option.

ingredients.name: Flambe wine (optional)
ingredients.notes: If using, be careful as flambe can be flammable.

instructions: Heat olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Saute the onion and garlic until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the diced red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the brown lentils, cumin, chili powder, and smoked paprika to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, until the lentils are lightly toasted.
Add the diced tomatoes, salt, and 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
If desired, flambe the dish with wine (ignite the wine carefully and let it cook for 1-2 minutes) and garnish with chopped parsley and a squeeze of lime juice.
Serve hot, garnished with additional lime wedges if desired.
